docs.title: Project Lumina Official Wiki
docs.text:
Project Lumina is a narrative universe set in a futuristic era where magic and technology coexist. Within this universe, characters and events come to life in stories, games, and more.

The universe and its related contents are mainly created and published by Melancholy and Coetus Interactive. However, Project Lumina is open to everyone. Anyone, simply by giving credit to the project and its creators, can make fan-made content and release it as part of the Project Lumina universe.

To suggest changes to this wiki or contribute with new material, open a pull request on GitHub.

docs.title: Project status
docs.text: Several Project Lumina products are in development, including a tabletop role-playing game, video games, this wiki, and a manga series. Some projects are active, while others are paused until the setting, resources, or team capacity are ready.

docs.title: How to help
docs.text:
Applications to join the official team are currently closed, but that may change in the future. Project Lumina is a non-profit project focused on creating enjoyable content and building a passionate community.

Even if you cannot officially join the team right now, there are several ways to help:

  • Give feedback and suggestions.
  • Volunteer as a tester for our early releases.
  • Use Project Lumina as inspiration to create your own games, stories, and other works, while crediting the original project.
  • In the future, we may open donations. Even one dollar can make a big difference for a small team like ours.
  • Join the community by making fan-made content, chatting with others, and spreading the word about the project.

docs.title: AI Disclaimer
docs.text:
We place great value on human work and creativity. We started developing games and products because we strongly believe in these ideas, in which brainstorming and authentic idea generation are part of our process. For this reason, no AI was used, neither fully nor partially, in the creation of our concepts, mechanics, level design, assets (graphics, drawings, sprites, fonts, sounds, music, etc...) or in any part of our creative writing (story, dialogue, etc...).

We believe AI tools are innovative productivity tools that should be used critically and intelligently, as support for people, not as a replacement, and never abused. We only use AI occasionally for coding tasks, such as optimization or solving very difficult bugs or issues, and even then, all changes are carefully reviewed, fully understood, and adapted to the codebase when needed. We also use AI to check and correct possible grammar errors, in order to guarantee high quality products.

docs.title: Project Lumina Products
docs.text: This page lists the main products connected to Project Lumina and their current development status.

docs.title: Seals of Lumina
docs.text:
• Type: tabletop role-playing game (TTRPG)
  • Status: in development
  • Main format: Logseq graph, PDF and possible physical edition

Seals of Lumina is a brand-new TTRPG system we’ve written from scratch. It features an innovative manual with tools for creating characters and campaigns, complete with original Project Lumina–themed rules

The first public release date is still to be determined. A limited group of beta testers is expected to play the game before the core rulebook is finalized. Future material may include additional manuals, ready-to-play adventures, and adjustments for different types of players.

docs.title: Garden 0
docs.text:
• Type: manga
  • Status: published online, with limited physical editions
  • Creator: Zaffy

Garden 0 is a manga created by Zaffy. It uses an innovative pixel art style and features several characters connected to other Project Lumina products.

The manga is published in English as a free-to-read online release, with limited physical editions in Italian and English.

Links

  • Read Garden 0 on Manga Plus Creators
  • Read Garden 0 on Global Comix
  • Garden 0 dedicated Discord server

docs.title: Lumina Nebulae
docs.text:
• Type: RPG, 8-bit, horror, turn-based combat
  • Status: in development
  • Creator: Melancholy

Lumina Nebulae is a small RPG with horror/creepy elements. It explores themes such as anxiety, fear, and depression.

The game is expected to be released for free on itch.io. Its source code is already public on GitHub, and updates can be viewed and compiled, although no official release is currently available.

Links

  • Official itch.io page

docs.title: Lumina Aeterna
docs.text:
• Type: RPG, bullet hell
  • Status: on hold
  • Related page: Lumina Aeterna

Lumina Aeterna follows a cultist who crash-lands on Earth after humanity has disappeared. The protagonist encounters strange creatures, some friendly and some hostile, while exploring several planets.

Development is currently paused so the team can focus on Seals of Lumina. Work may resume once the universe is more complete and the team has the skills, budget, and production capacity required for the project.

docs.title: Lumina Obscura
docs.text:
• Type: RPG, turn-based combat
  • Status: planned
  • Related project: Lumina Aeterna

Lumina Obscura is an RPG connected to the events of Lumina Aeterna. Development has not started yet and is expected to begin after Lumina Aeterna is finished.

The game is planned to include an original turn-based combat system with multiple characters, offering a broader view of the Project Lumina universe.

docs.title: Wiki Layout Guide
docs.text:
Each main page should follow this order:

  1. Title: use # **Title** heading with the page name.
  2. Short summary: one or two sentences explaining what the page is about.
  3. Quick facts: type, status, creator, first appearance, or other key details.
  4. Main sections: split long text into clear ## sections.
  5. Related pages: links to products, characters, locations, or contributors.
  6. Missing information: use an admonition when the page is incomplete.

docs.title: Product page template
docs.text:
# Product Name

One or two sentences describing the product.

## Quick facts

- **Type:** game, manga, manual, story, or other format
- **Status:** planned, in development, paused, released, or archived
- **Creator:** name or team
- **Related pages:** links to relevant pages

## Overview

Short explanation of the product and its place in Project Lumina.

## Development status

Current state, known release plans, and what is still missing.

## Links

- [Official page](page.md)

!!! note "Missing information"

    List the details that still need to be added.

docs.title: Writing rules
docs.text:
• Prefer short paragraphs over long blocks of text.
  • Use links with descriptive text instead of bare URLs.
  • Mark incomplete pages as stubs instead of leaving them empty.

docs.title: Garden 0
docs.text:
Garden 0 is a manga created by Zaffy. It uses an innovative pixel art style and features several characters connected to other Project Lumina products.

The manga is published in English as a free-to-read online release, with limited physical editions in Italian and English.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The manga follows Eyezor, the main character, an immortal combination of Divine, Human and Creation, Sona and Llyv, the first 2 characters Eyezor is going to encounter, and also the main side characters. Eyezor has just been revived by the Queen, the God of the Hive, an heavenly dimension, in contrast to the Nest, similar to Hell and ruled by the other God, The Sailor. The Queen has given Eyezor 3 main objectives: Bring back to the hive The Creator and The Astronaut, Find the 5 Jurors and kill Asha. The 3 will then embark on a journey of betrayal, elemental magic and suffering, to find out more about Eyezor.

The first volume is centered around the Prologue, about the Sailor's Betrayal, The Creator's escape and the creation of the universe.

docs.title: Development status
docs.text:
The project is currently on development, and the first volume is already online. If you want to be updated on the new volumes, you can join the Discord server below or check this wiki page.
